_instructions.DELETE_BEFORE_RETURN: Read _user.scenes and _user.about. Write that many detailed sections (author fields only). Studio composes official H3 three-block prompts. Copy about into logline (English). Invent title. Then DELETE _instructions and _user. Return ONLY valid JSON.
_instructions.SIL_SONRA_DON: Insan sadece _user.scenes ve _user.about doldurdu. Sen gerisini yaz. N = clip sayisi (varsayilan 12). Alanlar INGILIZCE ve DETAYLI. Resmi H3 3 blok Studio birlestirir. Sonra _instructions ve _user sil.

language.why: MiniMax H3 still + video prompts must be English. Turkish/other languages in visual fields hurt quality.
write_in_english: characters[].notes, voice, trigger (names may stay as proper nouns)
sections: title, location, character, action, camera, visual_style, audio, music, important, logline
language.dialogue_exception: dialogue may stay in the spoken story language (set dialogue_lang: tr|en|ar|…). Everything else = English.

_instructions.what_this_is: Text-only Film / face-lock package for MiniMax H3 Studio. Human writes clip count + topic only. You write the film. Studio later makes stills + per-clip video (t2v / continue). Studio composes official H3: integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music. No images or URLs from you.

defaults.sections_count: EQUALS _user.scenes (default 12). Add/remove section objects to match.
defaults.total_runtime: 12 clips x 5s = 60s (1 minute). Keep exactly 12 sections unless the user asks otherwise. 3 acts = 36 sections (3 x 12).
defaults.production_settings: Style, preset, duration, quality, steps and LoRA are selected in Studio and are never part of this JSON.

mode_field.t2v: NEW video — fresh clip (text-to-video / new beat). Use for shot 1 and for hard cuts (new location, time jump, different cast with no overlap).
mode_field.continue: CONTINUE from previous clip last frame (chain). Use when the same beat continues in the same space with overlapping cast.
mode_field.default_in_this_template: section[0]=t2v, sections[1..11]=continue for one continuous minute. Change a later section to t2v for a hard cut.

how_pipeline_works: 1) Read _user.scenes and _user.about only. Invent the rest. Visual fields ENGLISH.
2) Write exactly that many detailed author-field sections. First t2v; later continue unless hard cut.
3) User imports. Studio composes the official 3-block H3 prompt per clip. Nothing generates yet.
4) User clicks Produce: character/location stills, then scene videos.
5) No portraits/urls/base64 from you. No integrated_multimodal_description key in the JSON.

field_guide.title: Short section title (optional).
field_guide.location: Place name — must match a locations[].name when possible.
field_guide.character: Who is on screen — match characters[].name (comma-separate if multiple).
field_guide.action: ENGLISH. THIS 5s clip only. 2-5 present-tense visible sentences: body, hands, eyes, props, weather, light. Not a theme. Not one verb.
field_guide.dialogue: Spoken lines in THIS clip only. Empty if silent. May stay in the story language; set dialogue_lang. Do not force a language unless the story needs it.
field_guide.dialogue_lang: auto | tr | en | ar | … — language of dialogue; auto keeps text as written.
field_guide.camera: ENGLISH. Shot size + height + move. Vary across clips. Not the same line copied 12 times.
field_guide.visual_style: ENGLISH. Look for THIS clip if it differs from setup; else leave empty to inherit.
field_guide.audio: ENGLISH. Diegetic only. Becomes overall_soundscape. No BGM.
field_guide.music: N/A unless the user asked for score. Becomes non_diegetic_music.
field_guide.important: Must-lock details (costume, prop, continuity). Keep short.

cast_guide.characters: name + ENGLISH notes ONLY (appearance, age, wardrobe — this is the still prompt). Optional English voice tag. trigger = same as name. Leave lora_id empty. Do NOT add image/url fields.
cast_guide.locations: name + ENGLISH notes (architecture, time of day, weather). Notes become the location still prompt.
cast_guide.creatures: name + ENGLISH notes (anatomy, scale, color). Notes become the creature still prompt. No voice/lora.

rules: Human input is ONLY _user.scenes + _user.about. Do not ask more questions.
Write ALL visual fields in English. Dialogue may stay in the spoken language.
Fill author fields in DETAIL. Studio composes the official 3-block H3 prompt; production settings stay in the Studio UI.
Do NOT write integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music keys.
TEXT ONLY — no images/URLs/base64. Studio creates stills from name+notes.

human_writes_only.scenes: Integer = how many 5s clips. Default 12 (one minute). 5 = 5 clips. First clip t2v, later continue unless a hard cut.
human_writes_only.about: One paragraph: what the film is about. Turkish OK here; YOU translate the film into English fields. Dialogue may stay in the story language.

h3_prompt_format.do_not_write_the_three_blocks: Studio composes the official H3 prompt from author fields. Do NOT output integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music yourself. Do NOT paste those keys into action.
studio_composes_exactly: integrated_multimodal_description: SCENE – {title}. [Shot 1] {visual_style} Location: {location} Main character: {character} Action: {action} Camera: {camera} {character} (S1) says: <d>[{Lang}] {dialogue}</d> Constraints: {important}
h3_prompt_format.quality: Author fields must be DETAILED so the composed prompt is rich. Short generic beats (he walks, she looks) are rejected. Each action = 2-5 present-tense visible sentences for THIS beat only: body, hands, eyes, weather, props, light. Camera = size + lens feel + move + height (not just close-up). audio = diegetic room/Foley only. music = N/A unless the user asked for score.

_user.READ_ME_HUMAN: Fill ONLY scenes + about. Then send this WHOLE file to an AI. Do not edit other fields.
_user.READ_ME_AI: The human filled only _user.scenes and _user.about. Invent names, cast notes, locations, and every beat from that. Do not ask questions. Do not leave empty action/camera/audio.
